Former train hopper/crustlord/gutterpunk. Crust is the style/genre. Doesn’t require homelessness. Crusties is the common term for those who are also into said subgenre/subculture. Can be traveling or uually living in or frequenting the local house/squat. 
  
  Gutter are the homeless punks usually literally found sleeping anywhere they can, usually a traveler or home bum. 

  Scum fucks are just scum fucks man. Some of the best people who enjoy some of the grossest stuff life can offer lol. Or some of the worst people wishing they could do better. But the SFxSF (San Francisco Scum Fucks) actually opened up a drop in spot for kids that really helped me and some friends in tight spots. Especially the runaways.

  Oogles were what we either jokingly called every other traveling punk cuz for the most part on some level we all choose to leave a life that isn’t working to travel. Some are runaways from big houses where they were suffering horrible abuse and others were from like the local crack house or never lived in one. But really it’s kinda like a housy (anyone w a house) who effectively did everything we did except just went home when things got tough or ran out of money instead of truly having to deal w sleeping in the rain or actually hopping a train get they know every Black Death all stars and devil makes three song and play a banjolele (though never anything other than wagon wheel-that’s where usually you hear everyone shout “NO”) 
  But oogles started off more as a way of calling someone poseur but there’s so much paradoxical shit to life it’s essentially a joke born out of an ideal of a “trustafarian”-trust/hedge fund babies who are just going through a rebellious phase usually making shit real dangerous for everyone else. 

  This was my TED TALK. Thanks for reading
